clue.text: Thief in the kitchen?

parts.note: one who takes game illegally, and also the pan in which eggs are cooked gently in simmering water

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both an illegal hunter of game and a pan for cooking eggs, so a kitchen holds one.

clue.text: Dispute that foreigner docked tail of rodents

parts.note: a Pole, a native of Poland, serves as a stock foreigner

indicators.note: docking cuts off a tail, so the last letter of the rodents word goes

parts.note: mice are small rodents

explanation.surface: Someone disputes a foreign visitor who cut the tails off some mice.
explanation.definitionFit: A heated written or spoken attack in argument is a dispute, the noun sense.

clue.text: Stop being obstructive and confess

definitions.meaning: to let someone in rather than block their way

explanation.definitionFit: The verb means both to allow entry, ending obstruction, and to acknowledge guilt.

clue.text: That little squirt may have come from here!

definitions.text: That little squirt may have come from here!

parts.words: That little squirt may have come from here!
parts.note: a squirt of water comes from a garden watering tube, while a little squirt is also slang for a cheeky child

explanation.definitionFit: A garden watering tube is where a squirt of water comes from.

clue.text: Gather the agent will appear around midday

indicators.note: the agent's letters go around the midday letter

parts.note: a rep is a sales representative, an agent
mid-day: the middle letter of the word day

explanation.surface: A notice says the agent will turn up to collect around noon.
explanation.walkthrough: 'midday' is read as the middle of 'day', its letter A.
explanation.definitionFit: To harvest a crop is to gather it in.

clue.text: Power turned off at mains

indicators.note: turned and set off in a new direction, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: The electricity was switched off at the mains.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turned off' reads as switching off the supply, but it is the signal to rearrange AT MAINS.
explanation.definitionFit: Staying power or endurance is a kind of strength.

clue.text: Fabric made by wise man and fool

parts.note: a seer is a prophet, a wise man
a sucker is a gullible fool

explanation.surface: A cloth produced by a sage and a simpleton working together.
explanation.definitionFit: A light puckered cotton cloth is a well-known fabric.

clue.text: Fuss over small part old Bob takes up

indicators.note: in a down clue one piece written over the next comes before it

parts.note: ado is fuss or bother
PT is the short form of part
a bob was the old British shilling, abbreviated s

explanation.surface: Someone makes a fuss over a small role that an old fellow called Bob accepts.
explanation.walkthrough: A bob was the British shilling before 1971, written s.
explanation.definitionFit: To take on a child, idea or cause as one's own is to take it up.

clue.text: Note peril involved in trespass

indicators.note: involved as in tangled up, so the letters are mixed together

explanation.surface: A warning notice about the danger of trespassing.
explanation.definitionFit: To intrude where one has no right is to trespass.

clue.text: Review of the recital?

indicators.note: a review looks again and reworks, so these letters are reordered

explanation.surface: A critic's write-up of a concert performance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the' is the definite article, the definition sitting in the middle of the clue; 'Review' wants to be the definition, since a press piece is also called this.
explanation.definitionFit: In grammar, the word 'the' is the definite one of its class, alongside a and an.

clue.text: To give light cover, palms had to be replaced on end of promenade

indicators.note: letters replaced, put back in new places, are rearranged
the last letter of promenade is taken

explanation.surface: Palm trees along the seafront had to be replaced to give shade.
explanation.definitionFit: A shade over a bulb covers the light, so it gives a light its cover.

clue.text: Piece of eight

parts.note: a musical piece for eight performers, not the old Spanish coin

explanation.definitionFit: A composition written for eight players or singers takes the same name as the group.

clue.text: Yours truly gets poet wrinkling forehead

parts.note: yours truly is the speaker, me

indicators.note: wrinkling creases and distorts, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: The speaker has a poet frowning.
explanation.definitionFit: In anatomy the word is an old term for the brow, the forehead.

clue.text: Mysterious coteries dispersed

indicators.note: scattered about, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Secretive cliques were broken up.
explanation.definitionFit: Something understood only by a select few is obscure and mysterious.

clue.text: He's a beater for those who carry the guns

definitions.text: He's a beater for those who carry the guns

parts.words: He's a beater for those who carry the guns
parts.note: a beater sounds like a game drive's helper, but this boy beats a drum for marching soldiers

explanation.definitionFit: A young soldier who beats time on a drum for marching troops fits the description.

clue.text: Prisoners' main offence treason?

parts.note: cons are convicts, prisoners
the main is the open sea, and robbery at sea is the offence

explanation.surface: Is the inmates' chief crime treason?
explanation.walkthrough: 'main' reads as chief but is the sea; the question mark marks treason as an example of plotting.
explanation.definitionFit: Treason is often a secret plot against the state, the question mark showing it is one example.

clue.text: Immigrants from all directions arrive right inside

indicators.note: the arrive and right pieces go inside the directions piece

parts.note: the four compass points north, east, west and south
to come is to arrive

explanation.surface: Migrants come from everywhere and arrive with the right to stay.
explanation.definitionFit: People who have recently come to a country are new arrivals.

clue.text: Take forty winks? Less than twelve!

indicators.note: less than the full word, so its final letter is dropped

parts.note: a dozen is twelve

explanation.surface: Have a short nap, less than twelve winks?
explanation.walkthrough: 'Less than twelve' looks like a number, but it means the twelve word without its last letter.
explanation.definitionFit: To nap lightly is to take a brief sleep.

clue.text: Shot that comes off?

parts.note: comes off sounds like succeeds, but this shot bounces off a surface

explanation.definitionFit: A bullet or ball glancing off a surface is a rebounding shot.

clue.text: Bends the foreparts

explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a verb for bending forward and a noun for a ship's front ends.

clue.text: Have it in mind for the country

indicators.note: the word it goes into the mind word

parts.note: the brain is the mind

explanation.surface: Keep this country in your thoughts.
explanation.definitionFit: Great Britain is a country.

clue.text: Equipment carried by the army not a hindrance

indicators.note: not a means the letter a is left out

parts.note: impedimenta is the baggage an army carries

explanation.surface: An army's kit is no obstacle.
explanation.definitionFit: An obstruction is a hindrance.

clue.text: Time to get castle in Italy? In a way, understandably

annotationWithheld.why: Time to get castle in Italy? In a way, understandably (7): T + ITALY leaves C and A for 'castle', which no standard abbreviation gives, and no parse found
annotationWithheld.clue: Time to get castle in Italy? In a way, understandably

clue.text: Sharp pain when a robber first stuck in the knife

indicators.note: the a and robber pieces are stuck inside the pain word

parts.note: a pang is a sudden sharp pain

indicators.note: the first letter of robber is taken

explanation.surface: A sudden pain as the robber stabbed with a blade.
explanation.definitionFit: A Malay machete is a heavy knife.

clue.text: Devotee, although claiming I'm a procrastinator?

parts.note: the speaker, I
a procrastinator's motto is to do it later

explanation.surface: A fan, though claiming to put things off.
explanation.walkthrough: Split as I DO LATER, what a procrastinator says.
explanation.definitionFit: A worshipper of idols, or loosely an adoring fan, is a devotee.

clue.text: Liquor in tin commander in chief brought back

indicators.note: brought back, so the whole run is written in reverse

parts.note: a can is a tin
GOC is General Officer Commanding

explanation.surface: Drink in a tin, which the commander-in-chief brought home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brought back' turns both pieces together: CANGOC read backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: French brandy is a liquor.

clue.text: Boy turns up holding tail of hairy beast

indicators.note: the boy's reversed name holds the tail letter
in a down clue turning up reads the word from bottom to top

parts.note: Alan is a boy's name

indicators.note: the last letter of hairy is taken

explanation.surface: A lad turns up holding the tail of a shaggy animal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turns up' reverses ALAN to NALA, which holds Y.
explanation.definitionFit: A southern African antelope is a beast.

clue.text: Plant in the bed

indicators.note: the plant sits inside the words the bed

explanation.surface: A plant growing in the flower bed.
explanation.definitionFit: A shrub of the veronica family, from New Zealand, is a garden plant.

clue.text: Engagement ring?

parts.note: an engagement here is a fight, and the ring is where it is fought

explanation.definitionFit: A space where contests or battles take place is a ring for an engagement.

clue.text: From top branch, each stem could yield these nuts

indicators.note: the top, first letter of branch
could yield, give way, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Nuts may fall from the top branch of a tree.
explanation.definitionFit: The fallen nuts of the beech tree are called by this name.

clue.text: Floral offering embarrassing Sonya, for example?

indicators.note: embarrassing upsets and disconcerts, so the letters are mixed

parts.note: eg, exempli gratia, means for example

explanation.surface: A bunch of flowers that would embarrass Sonya.
explanation.definitionFit: A small bunch of flowers given as a gift is a floral offering.

clue.text: Try to use a different route to sea

indicators.note: made different, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Try another way to get to the sea.
explanation.definitionFit: A tidal river mouth is a passage leading to the sea.
